rows.label: Yom Kippur
rows.description: primary holy day in Judaism, tenth day of the new year
rows.hook: is the holiest day of the year, spent in full fasting and prayer to seek atonement

rows.label: Rosh Hashanah
rows.description: Jewish day of judgement preceding Yom Kippur (day of atonement), one of several Jewish New Years
rows.hook: marks the start of the new year and opens ten days of repentance

rows.label: Ganesh Chaturthi
rows.description: multi-day Hindu festival revering god Ganesha (August–September)
rows.hook: honors the elephant-headed deity with clay statues set up in homes and on public stages

rows.label: Sukkot
rows.description: Jewish holiday, harvest festival, festival of booths

rows.label: Diwali
rows.description: Hindu, Jain, Sikh, Buddhist and South Asian festival of lights
rows.hook: is the festival of lights, marking the victory of light over darkness

rows.label: Krishna Janmashtami
rows.description: annual commemoration in India on account of birth of the Hindu deity Lord Krishna
rows.hook: celebrates the birth of the eighth avatar of Vishnu

rows.label: Christmas
rows.description: holiday originating in Christianity, usually December 25
rows.hook: commemorates the birth of Jesus and is observed mainly on December 25

rows.label: Ramadan
rows.description: holy month of fasting for Muslims, observed on the ninth month of the Islamic calendar
rows.hook: is the ninth month of the lunar calendar, when Muslims fast from dawn to sunset

rows.label: Navratri
rows.description: annual Hindu festival
rows.hook: spans nine nights of worship honoring the goddess Durga

rows.label: Durga Puja
rows.description: Hindu festival in Indian subcontinent
rows.hook: honors a goddess for her victory over the buffalo demon, with grand displays in Kolkata

rows.label: Pentecost
rows.description: Christian holiday commemorating the New Testament stories of the Holy Spirit descenting upon the Apostles of Jesus
rows.hook: marks the descent of the Holy Spirit upon the apostles, fifty days after Easter

rows.label: Hanukkah
rows.description: Jewish holiday
rows.hook: lasts eight nights, with a nine-branched menorah lit to recall the rededication of the Temple

rows.label: Eid al-Fitr
rows.description: Islamic holiday on the first of Shawwal
rows.hook: celebrates the end of a month of dawn-to-dusk fasting with prayers, visits and shared meals

rows.label: Onam
rows.description: harvest festival of Kerala state, India

rows.label: Pitru Paksha
rows.description: ancestral Worship from Hindu religion

rows.label: Simchat Torah
rows.description: Jewish holiday marking the conclusion of public Torah readings

rows.label: Vijayadashami
rows.description: annual Hindu festival, celebrated at the end of Navaratri

rows.label: All Saints' Day
rows.description: Christian feast day
rows.hook: honors every holy person of the church, observed on the first of November

rows.label: Passover
rows.description: Jewish holiday celebrating the Israelites' liberation from slavery in Egypt
rows.hook: recalls the Exodus from slavery in Egypt, marked by a ritual meal and unleavened bread

rows.label: Raksha Bandhan
rows.description: annual ritual originating from the Indian Subcontinent

rows.label: Easter
rows.description: Christian commemoration of the resurrection of Jesus
rows.hook: celebrates the resurrection of Jesus after his crucifixion

rows.label: Purim
rows.description: Jewish holiday and tradition, celebrated on the fourteenth day of the month Adar
rows.hook: recalls Queen Esther saving her people from the plot of the royal vizier Haman

rows.label: Eid al-Adha
rows.description: Islamic holiday on the tenth day of Dhu al-Hijja
rows.hook: is the Feast of the Sacrifice, the second of the two main Islamic festivals

rows.label: Lent
rows.description: Penitential season in preparation for the observance of Easter
rows.hook: is a roughly forty-day season of fasting and penance leading up to Easter

rows.label: Assumption of Mary
rows.description: the bodily taking up of the Virgin Mary into Heaven at the end of her earthly life, dogma of the Catholic Church
rows.hook: is the Catholic dogma that the Virgin was taken body and soul into heaven, celebrated on 15 August

rows.label: Kumbh Mela
rows.description: Hindu pilgrimage and festival celebrated in India
rows.hook: draws enormous crowds of pilgrims, rotating among four sacred sites

rows.label: Good Friday
rows.description: Christian holiday
rows.hook: commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus and falls during Holy Week

rows.label: Epiphany
rows.description: Christian feast, public holiday in some countries
rows.hook: commemorates the visit of the Magi and is sometimes called Three Kings' Day
